_about: The three holders on the bed, as all-shapes-test.js draws them on the machine (hardware-verified). x, y = the holder centre in MACHINE coordinates (MPos), the numbers Tejas's tools move to with G53 (auto-position-test.py, jog-tool.py, all-shapes-test.js). After homing the laser reports HOME as about -30,-30, so the agent reads that and moves to the same spot a G53 move would. width, height = the keychain outline (mm): the border that is engraved; the name and photo go inside it. The printer agent and Laser Queue both read this file; Laser Queue's Test holders > Save here updates a centre. Restart the agent after a change.
